segments.speaker: Megan Lee, Account Executive
segments.text:
Hi Jordan,

Attached is the renewal summary for 84 seats, term 8/1/2026 through 7/31/2027. It keeps Support Plus and the reporting add-on, same billing contact as last year.

Can you confirm the seat count before I route the final quote?

Megan

segments.speaker: Jordan Price, Operations Manager
segments.text:
Hi Megan,

84 is right for now. We may add 6 more in Q4 but don’t want them on this renewal.

Can you also confirm invoices will still be net 30 and sent to ap@northvalecare.com?

Jordan

segments.speaker: Megan Lee, Account Executive
segments.text:
Yep, net 30 and AP email stays the same. If you add the 6 later, they’ll co-term to 7/31/2027 and show as a separate line on the invoice.

I’ll send the order form this afternoon.

Megan

segments.speaker: Jordan Price, Operations Manager
segments.text: Thanks. One thing before we send it over for signature: the PDF in the portal still shows $48,960. Your text this morning had $46,800. Finance wants to know which number to put on the PO.

segments.speaker: Megan Lee, Account Executive
segments.text:
Use $46,800 on the PO. I’ll get the PDF cleaned up after the back office items catch up.

Megan

segments.speaker: Jordan Price, Operations Manager
segments.text:
Got it. PO will be for $46,800, one annual invoice, start date 8/1.

Can you make sure the order form lists Michelle Tan as the signer? Our COO is out next week.

segments.speaker: Megan Lee, Account Executive
segments.text:
Yes, I updated signer to Michelle Tan, title VP Finance. Order form also notes renewal term 8/1/2026-7/31/2027 and 84 seats.

Sending now for e-sign.

Megan

segments.speaker: Jordan Price, Operations Manager
segments.text:
Received. Michelle is signing after her 3 pm call.

Please send the countersigned copy and invoice when it’s complete.

Jordan

segments.speaker: Megan Lee, Account Executive
segments.text:
Will do. Once signed, billing will generate the invoice within one business day and send it to AP with you copied.

Megan
